name: debank
description: A bank for a browser wallet. Connect MetaMask (or any EIP-1193 wallet) and the console becomes your account: total balance across every chain, accounts per chain, send and receive native coin or stablecoins, a statement of decoded history, the standing permissions that let someone else move your money — with one-click revoke — and a savings desk that places the account's stablecoins into curated index funds of yield venues (Aave, Compound, Morpho, Maple, Sky, Spark), each with live projected ROI and the liquidity locked in the protocol read from chain, entered with exact-amount approve+deposit signatures built here and signed only in the wallet. Powered by DeBank Cloud for the full picture (tokens, DeFi net of debt, NFTs, history, approvals — BYOK, every call spends the caller's own units) with a keyless floor that always works: native + USDC/USDT/DAI on 8 chains read straight from public RPCs. Twenty-four MCP tools, a REST API and the console over one port and one client.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

layout.mod.py: the anchor — every fn below, plus serve/kill/status/test
layout.client.py: the DeBank Cloud client plus the keyless bank rail: key resolution, retries, the normalizers, and public-RPC balances priced by CoinGecko
layout.mcp.py: MCP tool registry + JSON-RPC 2.0 (stdio and Streamable HTTP)
layout.api.py: REST + MCP + console on one port
layout.savings.py: the savings desk: index funds over yield venues — live APY join (defi module → DefiLlama → frozen hints), on-chain locked liquidity and holdings, approve+deposit plans, exit txs, off-tree ledger
layout.funds.json: the curated registry: 11 on-chain-verified venues and 4 index funds, each one asset on one chain
layout.console.html: the bank — connects to the browser wallet; overview, accounts, assets, savings, positions, statement, permissions, vault, send, receive, settings
layout.test/test_debank.py: offline tests: normalizers, chain aliases, MCP protocol

endpoints.chains: GET /chains?q=&refresh= — the one route that answers signed-out
endpoints.balances: GET /balances?id=&chains=&min_usd= — keyless: native + USDC/USDT/DAI on 8 chains via public RPCs
endpoints.networks: GET /networks — keyless: the bank rail a wallet can switch to (chain ids, RPCs, explorers, stablecoin contracts)
endpoints.funds: GET /funds?amount= — keyless: the savings index funds with live projected ROI and per-protocol locked liquidity; GET /funds/{id} for one (venue:<id> = fund of one)
endpoints.savings: GET /savings?id= — keyless: idle stablecoins vs money placed in each venue, read from chain
endpoints.savings_plan: GET /savings/plan?id=&fund=&amount= — the approve+deposit txs the owner's wallet must sign
endpoints.console: GET /debank (browser — the bank: connect wallet, send, receive, revoke)

mcp.auth: BYOK — x-debank-key header, DEBANK_ACCESS_KEY, or ~/.mod/debank/key.json; debank_chains, debank_balances and debank_networks answer without one

auth.model: BYOK — this module holds no house key
auth.note: an Authorization bearer is never read as a DeBank key — the gateway puts its own session tokens there

wallet.standard: EIP-1193 (window.ethereum) — MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, Brave
actions: savings: approve(venue, exact) + deposit/supply, redeem/withdraw — ERC-4626, Aave V3, Compound V3
wallet.rule: keys never leave the wallet; this server never sees a private key or signs anything
